items.title: 6.6 Applying Concepts of Conics To Real Life World Problems (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Book p. 211-215: 6.6 Applying Concepts of Conics To Real Life World Problems, Examples 29-35 (second printed Example 30 shown as 31), Figures 6.30-6.33

blocks.text:
Bachon, ab tak humne circle, parabola, ellipse aur hyperbola ki equations, foci, vertices aur eccentricity seekhi. Aksar students poochte hain: 'Sir, yeh sab kahan kaam aata hai?' Yeh section isi sawal ka jawab hai.
Aasman mein comet (dumdaar sitara) parabola par chalta hai, chaand aur satellites ellipse par, suspension bridge ki cable parabola ki shakal mein latakti hai, purane darwazon ke mehraab (arch) ellipse ya parabola hote hain, aur torch ya car ki headlight ke peechhe wala chamakdar shisha (reflector) parabola hota hai. Is section mein koi naya formula nahi; sirf pichhle formulas ko asal zindagi ke sawalon par lagana hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Har application wala sawal in chaar qadamon se hal hota hai:
1. Axes aise chuniye ke conic ki equation standard shakal mein aa jaye (vertex ya centre origin par). Yeh aap ki marzi hai, aur sahi choice sawal ko aadha aasaan kar deti hai.
2. Sawal ke naap (measurements) ko points ke coordinates mein badliye. Yahan sab se zyada dhyan chahiye: poora span ya aadha? vertex se naapa ya road se?
3. Koi maloom point equation mein rakh kar na-maloom constant (\(a\), \(b\) ya \(4a\)) nikaliye.
4. Equation se asal sawal ka jawab nikaliye, aur jawab lafzon aur units (m, km, cm) ke saath likhiye.

header: Applications mein kaam aane wali baat
rows: Focus \((a, 0)\); point \(P(x, y)\) focus se \(x + a\) door hota hai; focus ke sab se qareeb vertex hai; focus se nikalne wali shuaain (rays) reflect ho kar axis ke parallel jati hain.
\(c^2 = a^2 - b^2\), \(c = ae\); focus se sab se qareeb point \(a - c\) aur sab se door \(a + c\) par hai.
\(c^2 = a^2 + b^2\); kisi bhi point ke dono foci se faaslon ka farq \(2a\) hota hai.
blocks.caption: Hamara khulasa: is section mein istemal hone wali baatein

blocks.text: Pehli misaal ek comet ki hai jo parabola par chal raha hai aur Earth us parabola ke focus par hai. Sawal yeh hai ke comet Earth ke sab se qareeb kitna aayega. Yahan ek khoobsurat baat yaad rakhiye: parabola ka jo point focus ke sab se qareeb hota hai, woh us ka vertex hai. Is liye humein bas focus aur vertex ka faasla, yani \(a\), nikalna hai.

blocks.title: Example 29
blocks.problem: A comet has a parabolic orbit with the earth at the focus. When the comet is \(h\) km from the earth, the line joining the comet and the earth makes an angle of \(30^\circ\) with the axis of the parabola. How close will the comet come to the earth?
steps:
Diya gaya: orbit parabola hai aur Earth focus par hai; comet Earth se \(h\) km door hai aur Earth-comet line axis ke saath \(30^\circ\) banati hai.
Maloom karna: comet aur Earth ka kam se kam faasla.
Tareeqa: orbit ko standard shakal \(y^2 = 4ax\) mein lete hain aur Earth ko focus par. Sab se qareeb point vertex hai, to jawab \(a\) hai. Comet ke coordinates right triangle se likh kar parabola mein rakhenge.

Set up
Orbit \(y^2 = 4ax\) lijiye aur Earth ke centre \(E(a, 0)\) ko focus maaniye. Parabola ka jo point focus ke sab se qareeb hai woh us ka vertex hai. Is liye humein \(|OE| = a\) nikalna hai.
Kyun: vertex \(O\) origin par hai aur focus \(E\) us se \(a\) door. Agar \(a\) mil gaya to sawal hal.

Triangle \(EQP\) ki leti hui side
\[\cos 30^\circ = \dfrac{x - a}{h}\]
\[\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = \dfrac{x - a}{h}\]
\[x = a + \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}h\]
Kyun: Figure 6.30 mein right triangle \(EQP\) dekhiye. Hypotenuse \(EP = h\) hai (comet ka Earth se faasla). Axis wali side \(EQ\) hai, jo \(Q\) ke x-coordinate \(x\) se \(E\) ke x-coordinate \(a\) ko minus kar ke milti hai: \(x - a\). Angle ke saath wali side ke liye \(\cos\).

Khari side
\[\sin 30^\circ = \dfrac{y}{h}\]
\[\dfrac{1}{2} = \dfrac{y}{h} \Rightarrow y = \dfrac{h}{2}\]
Kyun: \(PQ = y\) angle ke saamne wali side hai, is liye \(\sin\). Ab comet ke dono coordinates \(a\) aur \(h\) mein aa gaye.

Parabola mein rakhein
Point \(\left(a + \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}h,\ \frac{h}{2}\right)\) parabola \(y^2 = 4ax\) par hai, is liye:
\[\left(\dfrac{h}{2}\right)^2 = 4a\left(a + \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}h\right)\]
\[\dfrac{h^2}{4} = 4a^2 + 2\sqrt{3}ah\]
\[4a^2 + 2\sqrt{3}ah - \dfrac{h^2}{4} = 0\]
Kyun: jo point curve par ho woh us ki equation ko satisfy karta hai. Bracket kholne se \(4a \cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}h = 2\sqrt{3}ah\) bana. Ab yeh \(a\) mein quadratic equation hai, jahan \(h\) ko ek maloom number samjhiye.

Quadratic formula
\[a = \dfrac{-2\sqrt{3}h \pm \sqrt{12h^2 + 4h^2}}{8}\]
\[= \dfrac{-2\sqrt{3}h \pm 4h}{8}\]
\[= \dfrac{(-\sqrt{3} \pm 2)h}{4}\]
Kyun: \(A = 4\), \(B = 2\sqrt{3}h\), \(C = -\frac{h^2}{4}\). Discriminant \(B^2 - 4AC = 12h^2 + 4h^2 = 16h^2\), jis ka square root \(4h\) hai. Phir upar neeche 2 se cancel kiya.

Sahi root chunein
Do roots hain: \(\frac{(-\sqrt{3} + 2)h}{4}\) aur \(\frac{(-\sqrt{3} - 2)h}{4}\). Doosra root negative hai (\(\frac{-\sqrt{3} - 2}{4} \approx -0.933\)), aur faasla negative nahi ho sakta, is liye use chhor dete hain:
\[a = \dfrac{(2 - \sqrt{3})h}{4} \text{ km}\]
Kyun: \(\sqrt{3} \approx 1.732\), to \(2 - \sqrt{3} \approx 0.268 > 0\). Yahi positive root hamara jawab hai.
Dhyan dein: kitab yahan ulta likhti hai ke \(\frac{-\sqrt{3} + 2}{4} < 0\); neeche 'Kitab ki ghalti' dekhiye.

Focal distance se tasdeeq
\[EP = x + a\]
\[h = \left(a + \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}h\right) + a\]
\[a = \dfrac{(2 - \sqrt{3})h}{4} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: parabola ka har point focus aur directrix \(x = -a\) se barabar door hota hai; directrix se faasla \(x + a\) hai. Is se \(2a = h - \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}h\) aata hai, yani wohi jawab, bina quadratic ke.
blocks.answer: Comet Earth ke \(a = \frac{(2 - \sqrt{3})h}{4} \approx 0.067h\) km tak qareeb aayega.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text:
1. Kitab mein jumla bigra hua chhapa hai: 'As point a parabola that is closest to the focus is it vertex'. Sahi baat yeh hai: parabola ka jo point focus ke sab se qareeb hai, woh us ka vertex hai.
2. Kitab likhti hai 'Since \(\frac{-\sqrt{3} + 2}{4} < 0\) so, neglect it'. Yeh ulta hai: \(\frac{-\sqrt{3} + 2}{4} \approx 0.067\) positive hai, aur yahi root rakha jata hai. Chhorne wala root \(\frac{-\sqrt{3} - 2}{4}\) hai, jo negative hai. Kitab ka aakhri jawab phir bhi sahi hai.

blocks.alt: Pale yellow panel par cyan parabola, vertex magenta axes X'X aur Y'Y ke origin O par. Focus par Zameen E(a, 0), parabola par comet (dumdaar sitara) P(x, y). EP = h x-axis se 30 darje ka angle banata hai; PQ = y axis par perpendicular (Q par right angle); EQ ke neeche teeron ke beech x - a likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.30: Parabolic orbit of a comet with the Earth at the focus E (original drawing after the textbook's Figure 6.30)

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Agar comet Earth se \(h\) km door ho aur angle \(30^\circ\) ki jagah \(90^\circ\) ho (yani comet focus ke bilkul ooper, latus rectum ke sire par), to \(a\) kya hoga?
Jawab: \(x = a\) aur \(y = h\); \(h^2 = 4a \cdot a\) se \(h = 2a\), yani \(a = \frac{h}{2}\). Formula \(a = \frac{h(1 - \cos\theta)}{2}\) bhi \(\theta = 90^\circ\) par \(\frac{h}{2}\) deta hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Chhota raasta: \(y^2 = 4ax\) ke har point ka focus se faasla \(x + a\) hota hai. \(EP = h\) aur \(x - a = h\cos\theta\) rakhein to:
\[a = \dfrac{h(1 - \cos\theta)}{2}\]
\(\theta = 30^\circ\) par yeh foran \(\frac{(2 - \sqrt{3})h}{4}\) deta hai.
Figure mein comet Earth se aage (vertex se door wali taraf) hai. Agar comet vertex wali taraf hota to \(x - a = -h\cos\theta\) aur \(a = \frac{h(1 + \cos\theta)}{2}\). Exercise 6.6 ke Question 1 mein bilkul yahi faisla karna parega.

Ab aasman se atom ke andar chalte hain. Bohr–Sommerfeld model mein electron nucleus ke gird ellipse par ghoomta hai aur nucleus ellipse ke ek focus par hota hai, bilkul jaise Sun planets ke orbit ke focus par hai. Numbers bahut chhote hain (\(10^{-11}\) m), lekin hisaab wohi ellipse wala: \(c = ae\), qareeb tareen faasla \(a - c\), door tareen \(a + c\).

blocks.title: Example 30
blocks.problem:
Elliptical Electron Orbit
In the Bohr–Sommerfeld model of the atom, electrons move in elliptical orbits around the nucleus, which is located at one focus. Consider an electron in an elliptical orbit with a semi-major axis \(a = 5.29 \times 10^{-11}\) m (the Bohr radius) and an eccentricity \(e = 0.20\).
(a) Find the distance from the nucleus to the centre of the ellipse.
(b) Determine the minimum distance (perihelion) and maximum distance (apoapsis) of the electron from the nucleus.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(a = 5.29 \times 10^{-11}\) m, \(e = 0.20\); nucleus ek focus par.
Maloom karna: (a) centre se focus (nucleus) ka faasla; (b) nucleus se electron ka kam se kam aur zyada se zyada faasla.
Tareeqa: ellipse mein \(c = ae\); focus se qareeb wala vertex \(a - c\) aur door wala \(a + c\) par hota hai.

(a) Centre se focus
\[c = ae = (5.29 \times 10^{-11}) \times 0.20\]
\[= 1.058 \times 10^{-11} \text{ m}\]
Kyun: eccentricity ki definition \(e = \frac{c}{a}\) hai, dono taraf \(a\) se multiply karein to \(c = ae\). \(5.29 \times 0.2 = 1.058\); power wohi rehti hai. Yani nucleus centre se \(1.058 \times 10^{-11}\) m door hai.

(b) Kam se kam faasla (periapsis)
\[r_{\min} = a(1 - e)\]
\[= (5.29 \times 10^{-11}) \times 0.80\]
\[= 4.232 \times 10^{-11} \text{ m}\]
Kyun: electron nucleus ke sab se qareeb tab hota hai jab woh us vertex par ho jo nucleus wale focus ki taraf hai. Woh faasla \(a - c = a - ae = a(1 - e)\) hai.

(b) Zyada se zyada faasla (apoapsis)
\[r_{\max} = a(1 + e)\]
\[= (5.29 \times 10^{-11}) \times 1.20\]
\[= 6.348 \times 10^{-11} \text{ m}\]
Kyun: sab se door tab hota hai jab electron saamne wale vertex par ho: \(a + c = a(1 + e)\).

Tasdeeq
\[r_{\min} + r_{\max} = 10.58 \times 10^{-11} = 2a\]
\[r_{\max} - r_{\min} = 2.116 \times 10^{-11} = 2c\]
Kyun: dono vertices ka faasla poora major axis \(2a\) hai, aur focus se un ke faaslon ka farq \(2c\). Dono baatein poori ho gayin.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Naamon ki wazahat: 'periapsis' aur 'apoapsis' aam lafz hain, yani orbit ka woh point jo beech wale jism (central body) ke sab se qareeb aur sab se door ho. Jab beech mein Sun ho to 'perihelion' aur 'aphelion' kehte hain, aur jab Earth ho to 'perigee' aur 'apogee'. Sawal mein 'perihelion' likha hai jabke solution sahi lafz 'periapsis' istemal karta hai; maths dono mein ek hi hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Agar eccentricity \(e = 0\) hoti to electron ka orbit kaisa hota, aur \(r_{\min}\), \(r_{\max}\) kya aate?
Jawab: \(e = 0\) par \(c = 0\), yani focus aur centre ek hi jagah; ellipse circle ban jati hai. Tab \(r_{\min} = r_{\max} = a = 5.29 	imes 10^{-11}\) m: electron hamesha ek hi faasle par rehta, jo Bohr ka purana circular orbit hai. Sommerfeld ne isi circle ko 'khench' kar ellipse banaya, aur \(e\) batata hai ke kitna khencha.

blocks.title: Numbering note (ours)
blocks.text: Kitab ne is safhe par 'Example 30' ka number do dafa chhapa hai: pehle electron orbit ke liye, phir neeche wale suspension bridge ke liye. Kitab mein Example 31 hai hi nahi. Hum ne bridge wali misaal ko Example 31 dikhaya hai taa ke numbering 29, 30, 31, 32 seedhi chale; kitab mein ise doosra 'Example 30' samajh kar dhoondiye.

Ab suspension bridge. Aap ne bare darya ke pul dekhe honge jin mein do oonche minaron (piers ya towers) ke darmiyan moti cable latakti hai aur us se khari zanjeerain (chains) road ko thaam leti hain. Jab road ka wazan barabar phaila ho to cable ki shakal parabola banti hai. Hum cable ki equation nikalenge aur phir ek khaas chain ki lambai.

blocks.title: Example 31
blocks.problem: The cable of a suspension bridge is parabolic. The roadway is 10 m, below the lowest point of the cable. The span of the bridge is 200 m, and the tops of the piers are 50 m above the roadway. Find the equation of the parabola. If the load is supported by vertical chains at intervals of 10 m, find the length of the chain that is 20 m away from either pier.
steps:
Diya gaya: road cable ke lowest point se 10 m neeche; span 200 m; piers ki chotiyan road se 50 m ooper; chains har 10 m par.
Maloom karna: cable ki equation, aur pier se 20 m door wali chain ki lambai.
Tareeqa: cable ke vertex ko origin bana kar \(x^2 = 4ay\) lete hain; pier ki choti ka point rakh kar \(4a\) nikalenge.

Set up
\(BAC\) cable hai, \(A(0, 0)\) cable ka lowest point (parabola ka vertex) aur \(DE\) road. \(Ax\) ko \(x\)-axis lein to parabola ooper khulta hai:
\[x^2 = 4ay \quad (1)\]
Kyun: latakti cable lowest point ke dono taraf ooper uthti hai, jaise U. Vertex origin par ho to equation sab se saada hai.

Pier ki choti ke coordinates
\[HB = 100 \text{ m},\quad AH = 50 - 10 = 40 \text{ m}\]
\[B(100,\ 40)\]
Kyun: span 200 m ka aadha 100 m har taraf. Choti road se 50 m ooper hai lekin vertex khud road se 10 m ooper hai, is liye vertex se choti sirf 40 m ooper hai.
Dhyan dein: yahan 50 rakh dena aam ghalti hai; height hamesha origin (vertex) se naapni hai.

\(4a\) nikalein
\[(100)^2 = 4a(40)\]
\[4a = \dfrac{10000}{40} = 250\]
\[x^2 = 250y \quad (2)\]
Kyun: \(B\) cable par hai, is liye (1) ko satisfy karta hai. Yeh cable ki equation hai.

Pier se 20 m door chain
Maan lijiye \(PR\) pier \(BE\) se 20 m door wali chain hai:
\[AQ = 100 - 20 = 80 \text{ m}\]
\[(80)^2 = 250 \cdot PQ\]
\[PQ = \dfrac{6400}{250} = 25.6 \text{ m}\]
Kyun: pier centre se 100 m door hai, to us se 20 m andar wali chain centre se 80 m par hai. Point \(P(80, PQ)\) cable par hai, is liye (2) mein rakha.

Chain ki lambai
\[PR = PQ + QR = 25.6 + 10\]
\[= 35.6 \text{ m}\]
Kyun: chain cable se road tak jati hai. \(PQ\) x-axis tak ka hissa hai aur \(QR = 10\) m x-axis se road tak.

Tasdeeq
\[x = 100:\ y = \dfrac{10000}{250} = 40 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: cable pier ki choti tak pohanchti hai. Symmetry (dono taraf ek jaisa hone) ki wajah se doosre pier se 20 m door wali chain bhi 35.6 m hai, isi liye sawal 'either pier' kehta hai.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Isi bridge mein bilkul beech wali chain (\(x = 0\)) kitni lambi hai? Aur pier ke saath wali?
Beech mein \(y = 0\), to chain sirf \(0 + 10 = 10\) m. Pier ke paas \(x = 100\), \(y = 40\), to \(40 + 10 = 50\) m, yani poora pier. Is tarah chains beech mein chhoti aur kinaron par lambi hoti jati hain.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Cable ooper khulti hai, lekin arch (mehraab) neeche khulta hai. Maan lijiye ek parabolic gate 8 m chaura aur 4 m ooncha hai. Choti ko origin lein: \(x^2 = -4ay\). Kinara \((4, -4)\) par hai, to \(16 = 16a\), \(a = 1\), aur \(x^2 = -4y\).
Centre se 2 m door: \(4 = -4y\), \(y = -1\), yani choti se 1 m neeche, zameen se \(4 - 1 = 3\) m ooncha. Exercise 6.6 ka Question 3 bilkul isi tarah hal hota hai.

Ab chaand. Chaand Earth ke gird ellipse par ghoomta hai aur Earth ka centre us ellipse ke ek focus par hai. Is liye chaand kabhi Earth ke thora qareeb (perigee) aur kabhi thora door (apogee) hota hai. 'Supermoon' jo aap ne khabron mein suna hoga, woh perigee ke qareeb wala poora chaand hota hai, is liye thora bara dikhta hai.

blocks.title: Example 32
blocks.problem: The moon revolves around Earth in an elliptical orbit, with the centre of Earth located at one focus. The major and minor axis of the orbit have lengths of 768,800 km and 767,600 km, respectively. Find the greatest and least distances (the apogee and perigee) from Earth's centre to the moon's centre.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(2a = 768800\) km, \(2b = 767600\) km; Earth ek focus par.
Maloom karna: zyada se zyada faasla (apogee) aur kam se kam faasla (perigee).
Tareeqa: \(c^2 = a^2 - b^2\) se \(c\) nikalein; phir apogee \(= a + c\), perigee \(= a - c\).

Semi-axes
\[2a = 768800 \Rightarrow a = 384400\]
\[2b = 767600 \Rightarrow b = 383800\]
Kyun: diye hue faasle poore axes hain, equation aadhe (semi) axes leti hai.

\(c\) nikalein
\[c = \sqrt{a^2 - b^2}\]
\[= \sqrt{(384400)^2 - (383800)^2}\]
\[= \sqrt{147763360000 - 147302440000}\]
\[= \sqrt{460920000}\]
\[= 21469.047 \approx 21469 \text{ km}\]
Kyun: ellipse mein \(c^2 = a^2 - b^2\). Itne bare squares calculator mein bhi ghalti karwa dete hain; aasaan tareeqa: \(a^2 - b^2 = (a - b)(a + b) = 600 \times 768200 = 460920000\).

Zyada se zyada faasla (apogee)
\[a + c \approx 384400 + 21469\]
\[= 405869 \text{ km}\]
Kyun: focus se sab se door point door wala vertex hai.

Kam se kam faasla (perigee)
\[a - c \approx 384400 - 21469\]
\[= 362931 \text{ km}\]
Kyun: focus se sab se qareeb point qareeb wala vertex hai.

Tasdeeq
\[405869 + 362931 = 768800 = 2a \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: apogee aur perigee mil kar poora major axis bante hain.
blocks.answer: Zyada se zyada faasla (apogee) \(\approx 405{,}869\) km; kam se kam faasla (perigee) \(\approx 362{,}931\) km.

blocks.alt: Flat drawing: gehre neele, sitaron bhare aasman mein upar baayen chhoti spiral galaxy. Beech mein Zameen (Earth) aur us ke gird Chaand (Moon) ka tircha halka ellipse wala orbit; orbit par upar daayen Moon. Laal dashed lines Zameen ke centre se guzarti hain, aur orbit ke dono siron se khari dashed lines neeche brackets tak: baayen Perigee, daayen Apogee.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Chaand ke orbit ki eccentricity kya hai, aur asal orbit taqreeban circle kyun hai? (Figure 6.32 mein orbit tircha dikhaya gaya hai.)
Jawab: \(e = \frac{c}{a} = \frac{21469}{384400} \approx 0.056\). \(e\) 0 ke bahut qareeb hai, is liye ellipse taqreeban circle hai; \(b\) aur \(a\) mein sirf 600 km ka farq hai. Lekin focus centre se 21,469 km hat kar hai, isi liye perigee aur apogee mein taqreeban 43,000 km ka farq aata hai.

Agli misaal ek proof hai. Satellite ke liye aam taur par apogee \(A\) aur perigee \(P\) maloom hote hain (ground stations naap lete hain). Hum dikhayenge ke sirf in do faaslon se orbit ki eccentricity mil jati hai. Yeh formula Exercise 6.6 ke Question 9 mein bhi kaam aayega. Proof ka andaaz simple hai: pehle har cheez ko \(a\) aur \(c\) ki zabaan mein likhenge, phir do equations ko jama aur minus kar ke \(a\) aur \(c\) alag karenge, jaise simultaneous equations mein karte hain.

blocks.title: Example 33
blocks.problem:
Satellite Orbit
The apogee (the point in orbit farthest from Earth) and the perigee (the point in orbit closest to Earth) of an elliptical orbit of an Earth satellite are given by \(A\) and \(P\), respectively. Show that the eccentricity of the orbit is \(e = \frac{A - P}{A + P}\).
steps:
Diya gaya: apogee ka faasla \(A\), perigee ka faasla \(P\); Earth ek focus par.
Saabit karna: \(e = \frac{A - P}{A + P}\).
Tareeqa: \(A\) aur \(P\) ko \(a\) aur \(c\) mein likhein, un se \(a\) aur \(c\) nikalein, phir \(e = \frac{c}{a}\) lagayein.

Alamaat (notation)
\(a\) = ellipse ka semi-major axis, \(c\) = centre se har focus ka faasla, aur
\[e = \dfrac{c}{a} = \text{eccentricity}\]
Kyun: orbit ko bayan karne ke liye yahi cheezein chahiye.

Perigee aur apogee
Perigee \(P\) satellite ka Earth se sab se kam faasla hai. Earth focus par hai, to yeh tab hota hai jab satellite us focus ke qareeb wale vertex par ho:
\[P = a - c\]
Apogee \(A\) sab se zyada faasla hai, jo saamne wale vertex par hota hai:
\[A = a + c\]
Kyun: vertex centre se \(a\) door aur focus centre se \(c\) door, dono ek hi line (major axis) par. Qareeb wale vertex tak \(a - c\), door wale tak \(a + c\).

Dono equations jama karein
\[A + P = (a + c) + (a - c) = 2a\]
\[a = \dfrac{A + P}{2}\]
Kyun: \(+c\) aur \(-c\) cancel ho gaye.

Pehli mein se doosri minus karein
\[A - P = (a + c) - (a - c) = 2c\]
\[c = \dfrac{A - P}{2}\]
Kyun: is dafa \(a\) cancel hua. Dhyan dein: \(-(a - c) = -a + c\).

\(e = \frac{c}{a}\) mein rakhein
\[e = \dfrac{\frac{A - P}{2}}{\frac{A + P}{2}}\]
\[= \dfrac{A - P}{A + P}\]
Kyun: upar neeche wale \(\frac{1}{2}\) cancel ho gaye.

Tasdeeq
Chaand (Example 32): \(\frac{405869 - 362931}{405869 + 362931} = \frac{42938}{768800} \approx 0.0559\), aur \(\frac{c}{a} = \frac{21469}{384400} \approx 0.0559\).
Kyun: dono tareeqon se eccentricity ek hi aayi, to formula sahi kaam kar raha hai.

blocks.title: Remark
blocks.text: Yeh formula har us elliptical orbit ke liye sahi hai jis mein beech wala jism (central body) ek focus par ho.

Ab parabola ki sab se mashhoor khoobi: reflection. Agar bulb parabola ke focus par rakha jaye to us ki har shua (ray) shishe se takra kar axis ke bilkul parallel nikalti hai. Isi liye torch aur headlight ki roshni ek seedhi lambi beam ki tarah jati hai, aur dish antenna door se aane wale parallel signals ko ek point (focus) par ikattha kar leta hai.

blocks.title: Example 34
blocks.problem:
A cross-section of a parabolic reflector is shown in the figure. The bulb is located at the focus and the opening at the focus is 20 cm.
(a) Find an equation of the parabola.
(b) Find the diameter of the opening \(|CD|\), 20 cm from the vertex.
steps:
Diya gaya (figure se): reflector ka cross-section parabola hai; bulb focus \(F\) par; focus par opening 20 cm, yani focus par axis ke perpendicular chaurai 20 cm hai, axis ke har taraf 10 cm.
Maloom karna: (a) parabola ki equation; (b) vertex se 20 cm par opening \(|CD|\).
Tareeqa: vertex origin par, axis horizontal (daayen khulta hua): \(y^2 = 4ax\).

(a) Latus rectum se
\[4a = |AB| = \text{latus rectum ki lambai}\]
\[4a = 20\]
\[y^2 = 20x\]
Kyun: focus se guzarne wali aur axis par perpendicular chord latus rectum kehlati hai, aur us ki lambai \(4a\) hoti hai. Focus par opening yahi chord hai. Is se \(a = 5\), yani bulb \(F(5, 0)\) par, vertex se 5 cm door.

(b) Vertex se 20 cm wale points
Vertex se 20 cm ka matlab \(x = 20\):
\[y^2 = 20 \times 20 = 400\]
\[y = \pm 20\]
Kyun: \(C\) aur \(D\) parabola ke woh points hain jin ka \(x = 20\) hai; ek ooper (\(+20\)), ek neeche (\(-20\)).

Opening ka diameter
Aadhi chaurai \(= 20\) cm
\[|CD| = 2(20) = 40 \text{ cm}\]
Kyun: \(C(20, 20)\) aur \(D(20, -20)\) ke darmiyan 40 cm hain.
Dhyan dein: 20 cm likh kar ruk jana ghalat hai; woh sirf aadhi chaurai hai.

Tasdeeq
\[A(5, 10):\ 10^2 = 100 = 20 \times 5 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: focus par opening ka sira parabola \(y^2 = 20x\) par hai, to equation sahi hai.

blocks.alt: Example 34, pale yellow panel par: cyan parabolic reflector, vertex V magenta axis par. Focus se guzarti magenta chord AB, axis ke dono taraf 10 cm; cyan opening CD, V se 20 cm door; V se CD tak kaala dashed double teer jis par 20 cm likha hai.

blocks.title: Example 35
blocks.problem: A parabolic flashlight reflector has the shape given by the equation \(x = \frac{1}{20}y^2\). Where should the lightbulb be placed so that the reflected rays emerge parallel to the axis?
steps:
Diya gaya: \(x = \frac{1}{20}y^2\).
Maloom karna: bulb kahan rakhein.
Tareeqa: focus se nikalne wali rays reflect ho kar axis ke parallel jati hain, is liye bulb focus par chahiye. Equation ko standard shakal mein la kar \(a\) parhenge.

Standard shakal
\[x = \dfrac{1}{20}y^2 \Rightarrow y^2 = 20x\]
Yeh daayen khulne wala parabola hai, vertex origin \((0, 0)\) par. Daayen khulne wale parabola ki standard shakal \(y^2 = 4ax\) hai, jahan \(a\) vertex se focus ka faasla hai, focus \((a, 0)\) par aur directrix line \(x = -a\).
Kyun: dono taraf 20 se multiply kiya. \(y\) square hai aur \(x\) positive, is liye parabola \(x\)-axis ke saath daayen khulta hai.

Muqabla karein
\[4a = 20 \Rightarrow a = 5\]
\[\text{Focus} = (5, 0)\]
Kyun: \(y^2 = 4ax\) ka focus \((a, 0)\) par hota hai.

Bulb ki jagah
Bulb parabola ke focus par rakhna chahiye. Reflection ki khoobi ki wajah se focus se nikalne wali har ray shishe se takra kar axis (\(x\)-axis) ke parallel bahar jati hai.
Kyun: sawal bilkul yahi chahta hai: reflected rays axis ke parallel.
Dhyan dein: bulb vertex par rakhna aam ghalti hai; tab roshni bikhar jati hai.

Tasdeeq
\[y = 10:\ x = \dfrac{100}{20} = 5\]
Kyun: \((5, 0)\) se guzarne wala latus rectum \(y = -10\) se \(y = 10\) tak, yani lambai \(4a = 20\), jaisa hona chahiye.

blocks.title: Remark
blocks.text: Reflection ki yeh khoobi yaqeeni banati hai ke focus se aane wali roshni axis ke parallel reflect ho; yahi usool torch, gaari ki headlights aur satellite dishes mein istemal hota hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Example 34 aur Example 35 mein kya rishta hai?
Jawab: dono mein reflector ki equation \(y^2 = 20x\) hai aur bulb \((5, 0)\) par. Example 34 mein humne opening ki chaurai se equation banayi; Example 35 mein equation di hui thi aur humne us se focus nikala. Yani ek hi cheez ko do taraf se dekha gaya hai: chaurai se equation, aur equation se focus.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Ek dish antenna 1.2 m chaura aur 0.2 m gehra hai. Receiver (focus) kahan lagayein?
Vertex origin par, \(y^2 = 4ax\). Dish ka kinara \((0.2,\ 0.6)\) par hai: \(0.36 = 4a(0.2)\), to \(a = 0.45\). Receiver vertex se 0.45 m (45 cm) door, axis par lagana hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Axes aise chunein ke conic standard shakal mein aa jaye; phir ek maloom point se constant nikal aata hai.
2. Parabola \(y^2 = 4ax\): focus ke sab se qareeb vertex (faasla \(a\)); har point focus se \(x + a\) door; focus se nikli rays axis ke parallel reflect hoti hain.
3. Ellipse jis ke focus par koi jism ho: kam se kam faasla \(a - c = a(1 - e)\), zyada se zyada \(a + c = a(1 + e)\), aur \(e = \frac{A - P}{A + P}\).
4. Cable ooper khulti hai \((x^2 = 4ay)\), arch neeche \((x^2 = -4ay)\); heights vertex se naapi jati hain, phir road ya zameen tak ka faasla jama ya minus karein.
5. Hyperbola: dono foci se faaslon ka farq \(2a\) (LORAN isi par chalta hai).

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Jahan aadha chahiye wahan poora span ya poora axis le lena (\(a = 384400\), 768800 nahi).
2. Vertex aur road ke darmiyan wala faasla bhool jana (Example 31 mein 10 m jama karna tha).
3. Ellipse ke liye \(c^2 = a^2 + b^2\) likh dena; yeh hyperbola ka rishta hai.
4. Faasle ke liye negative root rakh lena ya positive root chhor dena (Example 29 ki correction dekhiye).
5. Bulb ko focus ki jagah vertex par rakh dena.
